Cleanliness

Frequently asked questions

Are picnics allowed at Pinus Pengger?

Picnic rules are unverified. Ask staff on site whether it is allowed and in which areas.

Where is a comfortable rest spot?

Marked shaded areas and benches suit a short rest. Do not block visitor circulation.

Are there picnic tables?

The availability of picnic tables is unverified; ask staff.

How to handle rubbish?

Take back rubbish and food scraps. Do not leave plastic on paths or installations.
